recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-27793 unless a later work-group decision changes the typed-endpoint request-body rule.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 clarification asking that HTTP create and update request bodies at typed endpoints be resources of the named type, not arbitrary FHIR resources.

additional_context: The originating Zulip thread confirms typed resource endpoints must receive the same resource type except for operations, and the 2020-10-05 FHIR-I minutes record FHIR-27793 as Persuasive with a 7-0-0 motion.
reconciliation: Current source/http.html on the combined branch already contains the required named-type wording at the update and create sections. No source edit was needed; the published commit records the audit decision.
